_doc: Cach goi CLI cua tung agent o che do headless. {prompt} duoc thay bang noi dung that, {repo} bang duong dan goc repo. 'cmd' dung cho luot review: phai DOC va TRUY CAP WEB duoc nhung KHONG GHI duoc. 'write_cmd' dung cho luot tac gia. 'output_file_flag' danh cho CLI co stdout lan nhieu: orchestrator them co do kem mot file tam va doc ket qua tu do. 'model_flag' cho phep doi model mot lan chay bang bien moi truong AGENT_MODEL_<TEN> (vi du AGENT_MODEL_GEMINI=gemini-3.8-flash-high). 'write_unlock' mo tam quyen ghi o tang settings cho dung luot tac gia roi tra lai ngay sau do. Xem AGENTS.md muc 8. Codex da ngung dung tu 2026-10-15 (AGENTS.md dau file); cau hinh cu cua no nam trong lich su git.

write_cmd: Read Grep Glob WebFetch WebSearch Write Edit
claude.note: Da kiem chung 2026-09-09 bang subprocess: doc OK, WebFetch OK (ca dang cach nhau bang space lan dau phay), Write bi chan that. Khong dung --permission-mode plan: no chan luon WebFetch. Luu y: agent co the bao nham la WebFetch bi chan — da do lai va no chay duoc. Model chot 2026-09-09: --model opus --effort max (max la muc cao nhat; cac muc hop le: low, medium, high, xhigh, max). Khong co model nao ten 'ultracode' — 'ultrareview' la mot lenh khac, khong lien quan. SUA 2026-09-11 (ban ghi hom qua SAI): ultracode CO THAT va la muc cao nhat cua Claude Code — 'xhigh effort plus standing dynamic-workflow orchestration'. No KHONG phai mot nac cua --effort (--effort chi nhan low/medium/high/xhigh/max) ma la mot cong tac rieng: khoa 'ultracode': true trong ~/.claude/settings.json, khong co co CLI. QUAN TRONG: truyen --effort tren dong lenh tao 'launch-effort pin' va CHAN ultracode — binary noi ro 'the launch-effort pin holds effort at ... and ultracode needs xhigh'. Vi vay o day da BO --effort. Do thuc nghiem: chay khong co --effort thi session ghi "effort":"xhigh" (ultracode chay); chay voi --effort max thi ghi "effort":"max" (bi chan). Cach kiem: doc truong "effort" trong ~/.claude/projects/<repo>/<session>.jsonl. Ultracode can dynamic workflows bat va model/to chuc cho phep xhigh. LUU Y MAY KHAC: settings.json la file may-local, khong nam trong repo — may khac khong bat ultracode thi luot Claude chay o muc mac dinh cua may do ma khong bao gi.

gemini.note: Antigravity CLI (agy), khong phai 'gemini' CLI nua: Google da ngat OAuth cua gemini CLI cho tai khoan ca nhan tu 2026-06-18 (Gemini Code Assist for individuals / AI Pro / Ultra), chi con API key tra tien moi dung duoc. Dang nhap: agy dung chung phien voi app Antigravity da cai san. Model mac dinh gemini-3.1-pro-high; doi sang gemini-3.8-flash-high cho luot nhe bang AGENT_MODEL_GEMINI. Canh bao: 'agy models' co ca claude-opus-4-6-thinking va gpt-oss-120b — cam nham vao ghe nay thi luong mat gia tri ba model doc lap soi nhau. QUYEN GHI (do lai 2026-09-10, ket qua khac lan truoc): --mode plan va --dangerously-skip-permissions deu KHONG phai hang rao va cung khong mo duoc khoa; thu chan/mo duy nhat co tac dung la permissions.deny trong ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json — deny that su chan, loi tra ve nguyen van 'Matches user-configured deny rule'. Vi vay luot tac gia dung write_unlock: orchestrator go tam 'write_file(*)' khoi deny, chay, roi tra lai trong finally. Bay them: khong co --add-dir thi agy ghi vao thu muc scratch cua no (~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/scratch/) chu khong bao loi — nhin ben ngoai giong het nhu bi chan ghi. 'command(*)' van nam trong deny ca o luot tac gia: Gemini duoc ghi file, khong duoc chay shell.
